review_basis: Human visual review of rendered vector PDF sheet MI701. Expectations describe authored network-diagram evidence, not current engine output.

positive.title: DDC SYSTEM NETWORK DIAGRAM
positive.review_note: The sheet is a project-authored BAS/DDC network architecture with BACnet network line types and controller/device boxes. Raw vector topology is computable, but the complete semantic equipment-port-device graph is not independently proven. It is not a floor-by-floor piping riser and not installed-quantity evidence.
